ตาก.title: They’re not playing our song! North Korean anthem played at South Korean field hockey match
ตาก.summary:
NAGOYA, Japan (AP) — South Korean field hockey players were perplexed Friday when the national anthem of North Korea was played — instead of their own — before a men’s field hockey match against Bangladesh at the Asian Games.
South Korean players looked on, unsure of how to respond. Many South Korean players stood at attention, some ran their hands through their hair, and some left their right hand over their heart as the music played.
Organizers quickly corrected the problem and played the correct anthem.
South Korea won the match 5-0. The Asian Games open officially on Saturday.
South Korea’s Yonhap news agency called the situation an “awkward mishap.”
“Standing with their hands over their hearts in front of the unfurled South Korean flag, the South Korean players could not hide their bewilderment,” Yonhap reported.
“Belatedly realizing the mistake, the organizing committee played Bangladesh’s national anthem first before playing South Korea’s,” Yonhap added. “However, pressed for time ahead of the scheduled match start, the referee instructed players to exchange greetings while the South Korean anthem was still playing, forcing South Korean athletes to start the match without being able to sing the anthem.”
Some matches at the Asian Games have been played before the official opening to accommodate a crowded schedule which features more than 11,000 athletes, more than the Summer Olympics.

ตาก.summary_original:
NAGOYA, Japan (AP) — South Korean field hockey players were perplexed Friday when the national anthem of North Korea was played — instead of their own — before a men’s field hockey match against Bangladesh at the Asian Games.

South Korean players looked on, unsure of how to respond. Many South Korean players stood at attention, some ran their hands through their hair, and some left their right hand over their heart as the music played.

Organizers quickly corrected the problem and played the correct anthem.

South Korea won the match 5-0. The Asian Games open officially on Saturday.

ตาก.title: White lion cub seized from illegal hotel in Chiang Mai
ตาก.summary:
CHIANG MAI — 18 September 2026, A Chinese national has been detained after authorities found a 2-3-month-old white lion cub allegedly being kept illegally at an unlicensed hotel in Chiang Mai.
The raid was carried out at around 15:00 on 18 September by officers from the Natural Resources and Environmental Crime Suppression Division (NED), Chiang Mai district officials and the Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation’s Protected Area Administration Office 16.
Officers searched a building at 84 Charoensuk Road in Chang Phueak subdistrict, Mueang Chiang Mai district, following complaints from local residents about loud roaring noises coming from inside the building.
Residents reportedly said they had been hearing the noises since 5 September and believed they came from a dangerous animal.
The search was led by Pol. Maj. Jirayu Inkaew, an inspector with NED Division 4, and Nattakorn Chum-intharachak, deputy district chief of Mueang Chiang Mai.
Inside the building, officers found a white lion cub estimated to be 2-3 months old on the second floor. They also found photographs showing the lion as it had grown from a young age.

A 40-year-old Chinese woman identified as Wang told officers she was the building’s housekeeper.
Officials from Protected Area Administration Office 16 examined the cub and found that it had no microchip and that no permit had been obtained to keep it. The animal was therefore seized for further examination after the woman failed to produce documents proving legal ownership.
Authorities also found that the building had been renovated and converted into accommodation for tourists, reportedly catering exclusively to Chinese visitors.
Nattakorn said the building had previously been submitted for hotel registration, but the application had not been approved. Despite this, the premises allegedly continued operating as a hotel without a licence.
Wang was taken to Mueang Chiang Mai Police Station for legal proceedings. She faces charges related to possessing protected wildlife without permission and operating a hotel without a licence.
Authorities said they would also investigate the alleged financiers behind the property and any Thai nationals involved in acquiring the building.

ตาก.title: Thailand Ride-Hailing: Grab vs. Bolt vs. Maxim
ตาก.summary:
Choosing between Grab, Bolt, and Maxim in Thailand can take more thought than comparing the fare shown on your screen. Driver supply, prices, wait times, and service coverage can change by city, neighborhood, traffic conditions, and time of day, so the cheapest option isn’t always the quickest or easiest to book.

For most visitors, Grab is usually the most dependable choice, while Bolt often costs less when a driver is available. Maxim can also be useful for local trips and motorbike rides, especially in places where its driver network is stronger. In Chiang Rai, for example, local conditions can make the choice between Grab and Bolt different from what you’d expect in Bangkok or Chiang Mai, as this Grab vs. Bolt comparison in Chiang Rai shows.

Thailand’s updated ride-hailing rules took effect on March 31, 2026, adding compliance requirements for drivers, vehicles, and platforms. Next, we’ll compare what each app offers and how to choose quickly for your route.

App-based rides give you an upfront estimate, driver details, and a pickup point in one place. Traditional metered taxis can be cheaper for short trips when traffic is light, while tuk-tuks suit quick local journeys but usually require fare negotiation. Hotel transfers offer a planned pickup, although they often cost more than booking an app ride.

Grab, Bolt, and Maxim all work differently by city, time, and driver supply. Vehicle choices may include regular cars and motorcycles, but each app does not offer the same categories everywhere.

Grab is often the best starting point for international travelers because its interface feels familiar to many Southeast Asian visitors. It generally has the widest driver network in Thailand, which can make matching easier in Bangkok, Chiang Mai, Chiang Rai, Phuket, and other busy areas.

Grab also supports cash and, where available, card or in-app payment options. That flexibility helps when you have just landed or don’t want to negotiate a fare. The app is a strong baseline for airport trips, late-night travel, heavy rain, tight schedules, and destinations outside the city center.

Airport pickup rules vary, so check the meeting point before leaving the terminal. This Grab and taxi options from Suvarnabhumi Airport explains why the app’s listed pickup zone matters.

The trade-off is price. Grab fares can rise during busy periods, so dependable matching may cost more than waiting for another app.

Bolt often undercuts Grab on similar city trips, particularly during normal daytime hours. Therefore, it’s useful to check both apps before booking if you have a few minutes to spare.

Availability can change sharply outside busy neighborhoods. Matches may take longer or fail in quieter areas, outer districts, or late at night. Bolt works best for travelers who prioritize a lower fare and can tolerate a longer wait.

Bolt also offers scheduled airport rides with flight details at supported airports. Its Thailand flight-tracking update describes how the booking can account for flight delays.

Maxim is a useful third comparison app for travelers seeking lower-cost local trips or motorbike rides. Reports place it in Bangkok, Chiang Mai, Chiang Rai, and Phuket, although coverage can vary by neighborhood and time.

Before relying on Maxim, check the live map, estimated fare, available vehicle type, and payment choices inside the app. Its local driver supply may make it a practical option in one city but less useful in another.

ตาก.title: Thai Royal Navy Sets Strict Rules for New Frigate Contract
ตาก.summary:
BANGKOK – Thailand’s navy chief has officially laid down strict conditions for the nation’s next frigate procurement program. This high-stakes military contract must completely guarantee equal treatment for all competing international defense bidders.

Furthermore, the entire selection process will face full public scrutiny from the beginning to the end. The Thai military desperately wants to ensure absolute transparency for this massive national defense project.

The chosen defense contractor must successfully provide proven value across the entire service life of the warship. In addition, mandatory technology transfer remains a strictly non-negotiable part of this highly lucrative defense deal.

The Royal Thai Navy actively wants to boost its own domestic shipbuilding capabilities over the coming years. This bold strategic move aims to protect the country’s maritime interests while carefully securing taxpayer money.

The massive 16.73 billion baht frigate project has quickly attracted global attention from major international shipbuilders. Various defense firms from South Korea, Europe, and the Middle East joined this incredibly fierce competition.

Senior navy officials heavily stressed that the procurement process must remain completely fair and totally unbiased. Every single proposal faced a rigorous, detailed evaluation by a specially appointed military oversight committee.

The navy chief made it abundantly clear that political favoritism has absolutely no place in this deal. Expert evaluators judged each shipyard strictly on its technical merits, proposed pricing, and overall manufacturing capability. Recent official reports confirmed that South Korea’s Hanwha Ocean finally emerged as the overall preferred bidder.

Maintaining public trust remains a top priority for the Thai military during this current procurement cycle. The navy chief fully understands that local citizens want accountability for how public funds are spent.

Therefore, the national defense ministry will safely publish a detailed summary of the final selection results. This refreshing open approach successfully helps prevent corruption rumors and rapidly builds confidence in the armed forces.

Buying a modern warship is no longer just about simply acquiring a highly advanced floating weapons platform. The Thai Navy strictly insists that the winning defense bidder must share vital engineering and construction knowledge.

Technology transfer currently serves as a highly crucial pillar of Thailand’s long-term national maritime defense strategy. The developing country genuinely wants its own military engineers to directly learn advanced warship construction techniques.

Foreign shipbuilders must actively partner with local Thai dockyards to fulfill these incredibly strict contract requirements. This vital international collaboration will effectively create hundreds of high-paying jobs for skilled local maritime workers.

Over time, Thailand ambitiously hopes to build its own complex naval defense vessels entirely from scratch. This incredibly bold vision would significantly reduce the proud nation’s heavy reliance on expensive foreign military imports.

The required defense technology transfer covers everything from advanced hull design to complex combat system integration. Thai naval officers will also receive extensive, hands-on technical training regarding operating the brand-new digital systems.

ตาก.title: Thailand and Cambodia Clash on Maritime Claims at Hague
ตาก.summary:
BANGKOK – Thailand and Cambodia have taken their decades-old dispute over maritime borders and offshore energy resources to the international stage. The two Southeast Asian neighbors faced off before an international conciliation commission in Singapore, marking a new chapter in a complex diplomatic conflict. The dispute centers on overlapping claims in the Gulf of Thailand, an area believed to hold rich deposits of natural gas.

The United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) framework governs the current talks. However, both nations have laid out sharply contrasting positions on how to proceed.

The current conciliation process was initiated by Cambodia after a long-standing bilateral framework collapsed. In May, Thailand unilaterally withdrew from a 2001 Memorandum of Understanding (MOU), known as MoU 44, designed to manage the overlapping claims. The MOU covered a vast, 27,000-square-kilometer area of the Gulf of Thailand.

Cambodia argues that Thailand’s withdrawal left it with no choice but to seek international mediation. Cambodian Foreign Minister Prak Sokhonn told the commission that his country hopes for a “fair and lasting resolution” to open the door for offshore energy development. Cambodia is seeking either a final maritime boundary or an interim agreement to jointly develop and share the resources.

Thailand sees things differently. Thai Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow argued that the 2001 MOU was a failure, producing no concrete progress in 25 years. Thailand insists that a formal maritime boundary must be established before any talks about sharing oil and gas.

The opening statements in Singapore highlighted the deep mistrust between the two countries. Thailand accused Cambodia of playing the victim to gain international sympathy. Sihasak pointed to recent border clashes, which Thailand says injured its soldiers and killed civilians, as evidence that Cambodia’s actions contradict its claims of peaceful intent.

Thailand also firmly rejected Cambodia’s legal arguments. Cambodia relies on a 1972 continental shelf claim, which Thailand dismisses as having no legal basis. Furthermore, Thailand stressed that the UNCLOS proceedings apply only to the sea. They do not cover land disputes or sovereignty over islands like Koh Kood.

Cambodia has pointed to a successful UNCLOS conciliation between Timor-Leste and Australia as a model. That process led to a 2018 treaty that established maritime boundaries and a system for sharing gas revenue.

However, the circumstances in the Gulf of Thailand are different. While the conciliation panel can facilitate negotiations, its recommendations are not legally binding. It will likely take a year for the five-member panel to issue its findings. Until then, the valuable offshore resources remain untapped, locked beneath a sea of diplomatic disagreement.

In May, Thailand unilaterally withdrew from a 2001 Memorandum of Understanding (MOU), known as MoU 44, designed to manage the overlapping claims. The MOU covered a vast, 27,000-square-kilometer area of the Gulf of Thailand.

Cambodia argues that Thailand’s withdrawal left it with no choice but to seek international mediation. Cambodian Foreign Minister Prak Sokhonn told the commission that his country hopes for a “fair and lasting resolution” to open the door for offshore energy development. Cambodia is seeking either a final maritime boundary or an interim agreement to jointly develop and share the resources.

Thailand sees things differently. Thai Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow argued that the 2001 MOU was a failure, producing no concrete progress in 25 years. Thailand insists that a formal maritime boundary must be established before any talks about sharing oil and gas.

The opening statements in Singapore highlighted the deep mistrust between the two countries. Thailand accused Cambodia of playing the victim to gain international sympathy. Sihasak pointed to recent border clashes, which Thailand says injured its soldiers and killed civilians, as evidence that Cambodia’s actions contradict its claims of peaceful intent.

Thailand also firmly rejected Cambodia’s legal arguments. Cambodia relies on a 1972 continental shelf claim, which Thailand dismisses as having no legal basis. Furthermore, Thailand stressed that the UNCLOS proceedings apply only to the sea. They do not cover land disputes or sovereignty over islands like Koh Kood.

Cambodia has pointed to a successful UNCLOS conciliation between Timor-Leste and Australia as a model. That process led to a 2018 treaty that established maritime boundaries and a system for sharing gas revenue.

However, the circumstances in the Gulf of Thailand are different. While the conciliation panel can facilitate negotiations, its recommendations are not legally binding. It will likely take a year for the five-member panel to issue its findings. Until then, the valuable offshore resources remain untapped, locked beneath a sea of diplomatic disagreement.

ตาก.title: Warren Buffett steps down after six decades at Berkshire - 'Father Time always wins'
ตาก.summary:
Warren Buffett has stepped down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway, handing over leadership to his son Howard in the final chapter of a long-planned transition at the US business giant.

At 96, the world-famous investor will move into an advisory role as chairman emeritus and remain on the company board to offer his "judgement and perspective", according to a letter to shareholders, external.

The decision comes nine months after Buffett passed the chief executive role to Greg Abel, with his son, Howard, who has been a director since 1993, taking over non-executive board duties.

Known as the "Oracle of Omaha," Buffett built one of the most successful investment track records in modern history.

He took control of Berkshire Hathaway in 1965 when it was a struggling New England textile mill and turned it into a $1.1 trillion (Â£822b), global conglomerate.

Today, the business owns a wide range of well-known brands including GEICO car insurance, Dairy Queen, and BNSF railway system. It also owns large stakes in companies like Apple and Coca-Cola â a brand close to Buffett's heart, as he famously drinks five cans a day.

Buffett has made his mark through "value investing" â a strategy focused on finding companies with solid fundamentals, buying them at fair prices, and holding them for decades.

His annual letters to shareholders and festival-like annual meetings turned him into a leading mentor across the financial world.

Despite his retirement from the top board post, the change is considered an orderly passing of the baton rather than a sudden shock.

"The timing is right to complete the transition," Buffett wrote, noting he had recently celebrated his 96th birthday and the first birthday of one of his great-grandchildren, who is "moving a bit faster" than he is.

The company assured investors that day-to-day operations will remain steady.

While Greg Abel manages corporate strategy and capital decisions, Howard Buffett's main duty as chairman will be guarding the firm's "culture and values". A former farmer, philanthropist, and sheriff, the younger Buffett brings more than three decades of board experience to the role.

Buffett concluded his letter by saying it had been the "privilege of a lifetime" to serve as chairman, but acknowledged that in the end, "Father Time always wins".

ตาก.title: England fast bowler Carse to face no charges over alleged nightclub assault
ตาก.summary:
England fast bowler Brydon Carse will face no charges after an investigation into an alleged assault was closed by Derbyshire Police, the force has said.

But the 31-year-old remains subject to a separate probe by the Cricket Regulator, the disciplinary arm of the English game, who will assess if he has a case to answer under their regulations.

Carse was handcuffed by officers after a celebratory night out with Durham teammates on August 23 in Derby, central England, and it was later confirmed he had been arrested on suspicion of being drunk and disorderly, before being “de-arrested” after agreeing to depart.

Derbyshire Police said they were investigating an alleged assault in connection with the incident but have now decided no further action will be taken.

In a statement on Friday, the force said: “An investigation into reports of an assault in Derby city centre has been closed.

“Officers attended Molly Malones in the Wardwick, Derby, in the early hours of Sunday 23 August. A man was arrested on suspicion of being drunk and disorderly and was then de-arrested after his details were taken by officers.”

Subsequent enquiries were made pursuing the allegations of an assault but, after the alleged victim was identified and spoken to, no further action was taken, police said.

Videos of Carse’s arrest were released on social media, with Carse seen talking to Durham teammate Matthew Potts, while former England captain Ben Stokes – who also plays for northeast county Durham – was pictured in the background.

Carse, who has taken 58 wickets in 14 Tests at a shade more than 30 apiece, has continued playing for Durham since the episode took place, helping the side win the Second Division title in the first-class County Championship.

Carse was immediately removed from the squad before the second Test against Pakistan, then left out of the final match too, having not been selected on cricketing grounds for the opening encounter of a series where England whitewashed the tourists 3-0.

While officially available for selection for the ongoing white-ball series against Sri Lanka, he was again omitted.

England’s limited-overs head coach Brendon McCullum, speaking earlier this week, reminded his side of their off-field responsibilities, adding: “I’ve spoken to Carsey a lot and it’s the same message – you need to make good decisions off the field that allow you to be able to be the best version of yourself.

“As far as Carsey is concerned, it’s a good chance for him now to get his house in order and then push for selection for the next opportunity that arises.”

Carse’s arrest was the latest in a series of alcohol-fuelled controversies that have dogged England since their disastrous tour of New Zealand and Australia at the end of last year.

Test captain Joe Root, speaking before the Lord’s Test, said he was “hacked off” by the growing list of drink-related incidents involving England cricketers.

Turning to Carse, he said, “I don’t think I’m speaking out of turn in saying he’s very upset, very apologetic and understands his actions. I’m sure when he gets his chance, he will say that himself.”

ตาก.title: 1 killed, 4 injured in shooting near Mae Ramphueng Beach
ตาก.summary:
RAYONG — 18 September 2026, A man was killed and four people were injured after two groups of teenagers exchanged gunfire near Mae Ramphueng Beach in Rayong late Thursday night, with a bystander among those hit.
The shooting took place near the venue of the “Mae Ramphueng Beach: Colors of the Eastern Region” festival, which runs from Sept. 18–20 and features concerts by popular artists each night. The concert on Thursday night was performed by the band Maleehuana.
After the concert ended, tourists began leaving the venue when two groups of teenagers reportedly got into an argument. The groups exchanged insults and shouted challenges at each other before appearing to disperse.
Several gunshots were then heard.
A bullet struck Panandat, who was not involved in the confrontation and was on his way home. He died at the scene.
Four other teenagers involved in the altercation were also injured after being caught in the gunfire.
A member of the public reportedly captured video of the incident. Investigators at Muang Rayong Police Station are examining the footage as evidence and have identified a suspect believed to be the shooter.
Police investigators are urgently searching for the suspect and preparing to take legal action.

ตาก.title: Tourist police reunite lost 9-year-old Russian boy with mother
ตาก.summary:
SURAT THANI — 19 September 2026, Tourist police on Koh Phangan reunited a 9-year-old Russian boy with his mother early Friday after he became separated from his family and was found alone on a road, frightened and seeking help.
At 04:15, a Dutch passerby contacted the Tourist Police hotline at 1155 after seeing a boy, believed to be about 9 years old, running along the road and crying for help.
Pol. Lt. Col. Winit Boonchit, deputy inspector of Tourist Police Station 5, Division 2, Tourist Police Bureau 3, ordered officers on Koh Phangan to investigate.
Officers found the boy in an extremely frightened state. He spoke Russian and could not communicate in English, so police arranged for a Russian interpreter to assist with the investigation.
The boy, identified as Jaromir, 9, told the interpreter that he had been staying at a house with his mother. At around 04:00, he woke up and discovered that his mother was not there.
Frightened, he left the house and walked to a main road about 5 kilometers from the residence. He could not remember the way home and began asking passing people for help.

With few people and tourists on the road at that hour, the boy eventually ran along the road until the Dutch passerby spotted him and called 1155, concerned that he could be in danger.
Tourist police took the boy to their Koh Phangan service center and began searching for his family. Officers checked CCTV footage from the area where he was first found, which helped them identify his mother, a Russian national named Alisa.
Police also checked the Tourist Police Station on Koh Samui’s system and obtained information about her accommodation and telephone number.
Officers contacted Alisa and informed her that her son was safe and in police custody. She was asked to come and collect him.
Alisa told police that she had put her son to bed as usual. After he fell asleep, she went to a close friend’s house because the friend was due to return to Russia the following day. She left her sleeping son alone at the residence.
She said she was extremely shocked when she learned what had happened and apologized for the incident.
Alisa thanked the tourist police and the Dutch passerby for helping her son and ensuring his safety. She said she would take greater care of him and would not allow a similar incident to happen again.
The tourist police then escorted the mother and her son back to their accommodation, where they were reunited safely.
The incident was highlighted by authorities as part of efforts to strengthen confidence in tourist safety and promote Koh Phangan as a safe destination for visitors.

ตาก.title: Indonesia welcomes its first aircraft carrier, prompting debate over cost and military ambitions
ตาก.summary:
JAKARTA, Indonesia (AP) — Indonesia welcomed its first aircraft carrier Friday, a former Italian warship that the government says will strengthen the archipelago nation’s maritime security and disaster response capabilities.
The 41-year-old former ITS Giuseppe Garibaldi, with capacity for short takeoff and vertical landing aircraft and helicopters, was welcomed with a military ceremony upon its arrival at a naval base in North Jakarta’s Tanjung Priok seaport.
Italy in March agreed to give the carrier, which was retired in 2024, to Indonesia in a move aimed at boosting Italy’s broader defense engagement with the Southeast Asian country. Italy is seeking deals on submarines and aircraft, and gifting the carrier to Indonesia also saves it the cost of decommissioning the ship.
“We intend to use the ship primarily for military operations other than war, although it can also be deployed for combat missions if necessary,” Indonesian Navy chief Adm. Muhammad Ali told reporters after the ceremony. He said the carrier could serve the navy for another 15 to 20 years and could accommodate 14 helicopters or more, depending on their size.
Indonesia will become the second country in Southeast Asia with an aircraft carrier. Thailand’s HTMS Chakri Naruebet was commissioned in 1997 after being procured from Spain along with carrier-capable AV-8S Matador jump jets.
Indonesian Navy personnel salute as the Giuseppe Garibaldi, a former Italian Navy aircraft carrier, arrives at Tanjung Priok port in Jakarta, Indonesia, Friday, Sept. 18, 2026. Indonesia’s first aircraft carrier, the Italian Navy’s former carrier Giuseppe Garibaldi, arrived in Jakarta on Sept 18 after a three-week voyage from Italy, marking a significant expansion of the country’s naval capabilities. (AP Photo/Tatan Syuflana)
Ali said the carrier will be commissioned into the navy next week as the KRI Sriwijaya, honoring the Srivijaya empire, a maritime kingdom based in Sumatra that became one of Southeast Asia’s dominant naval and trading powers between the seventh and 13th centuries. Previously, the navy would name the carrier as KRI Gajah Mada.
Defense development was one of the top priorities for President Prabowo Subianto’s administration, as he has advocated an expansion of the military through the purchase of submarines, frigates, fighter jets, and missiles and pushed for more defense cooperation with various countries.
But the Garibaldi acquisition has raised questions about whether Indonesia needs an aircraft carrier at all and whether the government should be spending millions of dollars to refurbish and operate an aging warship.
Indonesia’s Finance Ministry approved $450 million in financing for the aircraft carrier program in 2025. However, some lawmakers have warned the overall bill could be far higher. TB Hasanuddin, a member of Parliament’s Commission I, said the cost of retrofitting the carrier alone could reach 16 trillion rupiah (about $900 million).
Indonesia to convert the Garibaldi for handling disasters
Unlike major naval powers that use aircraft carriers to launch fighter jets far from home shores, Indonesia views the vessel as a mobile command center and support hub for helicopters, uncrewed aircraft and maritime operations across its thousands of islands.
Speaking during a disaster management meeting early this month, Prabowo said the vessel would help authorities combat forest and peatland fires that regularly blanket parts of Southeast Asia with hazardous haze.

ตาก.title: Chiang Mai gambling den raids uncover alleged links to local politicians
ตาก.summary:
CHIANG MAI — 18 September 2026, Thailand’s Department of Provincial Administration raided two major gambling dens in central Chiang Mai on Thursday night, arresting more than 100 gamblers and seizing cash and gambling chips worth more than 2 million baht.
The operation was led by Noppal Pheer Suwannachai, head of a special operations team from the Department of Provincial Administration, following complaints from residents about large gambling operations allegedly operating in local communities.
The first raid targeted Phattharawan gambling den in the Santitham community. Officers entered the first floor of Phattharawan Place on Soi Sermsuk Road in Chang Phueak subdistrict, Mueang Chiang Mai district.
The area had reportedly been converted into a large gambling hall offering several types of gambling, including Hi-Lo, fish-shooting arcade games and baccarat.

The venue had strict security measures, with a counter for collecting gamblers’ mobile phones and body searches conducted before entry.
The second raid targeted Si Ping Muang gambling den in the Haiya community, located at Kad Wiang Ping food centre on Si Ping Muang Road in Haiya subdistrict.
The single-storey building reportedly had only one entrance and exit, with security guards strictly collecting communication devices from visitors.
Inside, officers found gambling involving animal pictures and a traditional dice game known as Nam Tao Pu Pla, also referred to locally as Mak Hok Lok or Bak Tok Khon. The game used four animal-shaped dice on a large table.

Foreign workers were reportedly employed to take bets and pay out winnings. Both Thai and foreign gamblers were said to have frequented the venue throughout the day.
The raids followed complaints received by the Department of Provincial Administration. Officials from its Investigation and Legal Affairs Bureau conducted surveillance and undercover investigations at the two locations before gathering sufficient information to launch the operation.
Investigators found that both gambling dens had extensive security systems designed to detect approaching authorities, including dozens of surveillance cameras and guards monitoring the premises.
Officials also allegedly observed gambling operators collecting cash and placing it in large handbags, reportedly for delivery to people believed to be behind the operations.

Some Cambodian nationals were also found working at the venues, potentially violating Thailand’s Gambling Act of 1935 and the Emergency Decree on Non-Thai Nationals’ Working Management of 2017.
Special operations officers simultaneously surrounded both locations to prevent escapes and quickly took control of the premises.
Authorities arrested more than 100 gamblers, including two foreign nationals, as well as 14 people allegedly organising the gambling, including eight foreign nationals, and four people accused of supporting the gambling operations.
Officials seized cash and gambling chips worth more than 2 million baht, along with gambling equipment, financial records and rental documents.
Some of the rental documents were reportedly linked to local politicians.

Mysterious call raises questions over political links

ตาก.title: 73 motorists report asphalt damage on Bangkok’s Rama 9 Road
ตาก.summary:
BANGKOK — 19 September 3026, At least 73 motorists have filed police reports after falling asphalt damaged vehicles on Rama 9 Road, with Mercedes-Benz, BMW, electric vehicles and passenger cars among those affected.
The victims went to Huamark Police Station to report damage caused by asphalt that fell onto vehicles traveling on the outbound side of Rama 9 Road, between the Rama 9 and Ramkhamhaeng intersections.
The road was undergoing resurfacing work on an elevated section when the asphalt reportedly fell onto passing vehicles.
The latest person to file a report was Chantima, 29, the owner of a gray Honda City. She became the 73rd reported victim and filed a complaint with Pol. Lt. Col. Parama Lodsukho, a deputy investigator at Huamark Police Station.
Chantima said asphalt fell onto her car as she was driving home from work. She regularly uses the route and initially did not realize that her vehicle had been hit.
After getting out of the car, however, she discovered damage along the vehicle’s right side, extending from the front bumper to the rear bumper. The car remained driveable.
She said she was seeking compensation from the contractor and other parties involved, urging them to take greater precautions and schedule roadwork at times when traffic is lighter.

Police said they would arrange discussions between the victims and those responsible over compensation.
Pol. Lt. Col. Thawanun Ngoen-yuang, an investigator at Huamark Police Station, said police had contacted the contractor and informed the company that the incident could constitute negligence resulting in damage to other people’s property.
Victims have continued to come forward, with the 73rd person filing a report at about 13:00 on Friday. Police believe the number of affected motorists could increase.
The contractor has acknowledged the incident and expressed willingness to compensate victims for the damage.
Police found that numerous vehicles had been affected, including Mercedes-Benz and BMW cars, electric vehicles and other passenger cars. Some vehicles sustained damage to their hoods, roofs and trunks after asphalt droplets landed on or splattered across the vehicles.

ตาก.title: Tourist police reunite lost 9-year-old Russian boy with mother
ตาก.summary:
SURAT THANI — 19 September 2026, Tourist police on Koh Phangan reunited a 9-year-old Russian boy with his mother early Friday after he became separated from his family and was found alone on a road, frightened and seeking help.
At 04:15, a Dutch passerby contacted the Tourist Police hotline at 1155 after seeing a boy, believed to be about 9 years old, running along the road and crying for help.
Pol. Lt. Col. Winit Boonchit, deputy inspector of Tourist Police Station 5, Division 2, Tourist Police Bureau 3, ordered officers on Koh Phangan to investigate.
Officers found the boy in an extremely frightened state. He spoke Russian and could not communicate in English, so police arranged for a Russian interpreter to assist with the investigation.
The boy, identified as Jaromir, 9, told the interpreter that he had been staying at a house with his mother. At around 04:00, he woke up and discovered that his mother was not there.
Frightened, he left the house and walked to a main road about 5 kilometers from the residence. He could not remember the way home and began asking passing people for help.

With few people and tourists on the road at that hour, the boy eventually ran along the road until the Dutch passerby spotted him and called 1155, concerned that he could be in danger.
Tourist police took the boy to their Koh Phangan service center and began searching for his family. Officers checked CCTV footage from the area where he was first found, which helped them identify his mother, a Russian national named Alisa.
Police also checked the Tourist Police Station on Koh Samui’s system and obtained information about her accommodation and telephone number.
Officers contacted Alisa and informed her that her son was safe and in police custody. She was asked to come and collect him.
Alisa told police that she had put her son to bed as usual. After he fell asleep, she went to a close friend’s house because the friend was due to return to Russia the following day. She left her sleeping son alone at the residence.
She said she was extremely shocked when she learned what had happened and apologized for the incident.
Alisa thanked the tourist police and the Dutch passerby for helping her son and ensuring his safety. She said she would take greater care of him and would not allow a similar incident to happen again.
The tourist police then escorted the mother and her son back to their accommodation, where they were reunited safely.
The incident was highlighted by authorities as part of efforts to strengthen confidence in tourist safety and promote Koh Phangan as a safe destination for visitors.

ตาก.title: India finds Nestle baby food sample substandard, takes legal action
ตาก.summary:
The scrutiny is the latest in a crackdown on India’s US$100 billion (S$127 billion) food industry which has included surprise factory visits and product testing.

NEW DELHI: India’s food regulator said on Friday (Sep 18) it had found a Nestle baby food sample to be substandard and was pursuing legal action against the Swiss company in one of its biggest growth markets.

Nestle said its products are “fully compliant with all the applicable regulations” and that it will continue to work closely with the regulator, without specifically commenting on the finding of a substandard sample.

The scrutiny is the latest in a crackdown on India’s US$100 billion (S$127 billion) food industry which has included surprise factory visits and product testing.

Officials found a sample of Nestle “follow-up formula”, which is a milk product for infants, was “substandard with respect to biotin”, the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) said.

The regulator specifies a standardised reference range for biotin, more commonly known as vitamin B7, in baby food.

“A reanalysis” of the sample found it was “non-conforming” with respect to prescribed biotin requirements under Indian laws, the regulator said in a social media post.

The FSSAI did not say whether it would order a recall of the product.

ตาก.title: Surfing-Brooks takes three-peat at Trestles Pro; Pupo claims men's win for Brazil
ตาก.summary:
Sept 18 : Canadian teenage surfing phenomenon Erin Brooks claimed her third straight world championship tour event on Friday with a win at the Trestles Pro, while Brazil's Miguel Pupo took out Japan's Kanoa Igarashi for his second win of the year.

Identified early as a potential world champion, the 19-year-old Brooks struggled in the first six events of her sophomore season, failing to make it out of the second round. But a spectacular performance saw her claim a win in the heaving barrels of Tahiti, and she backed it up at another powerful South Pacific reef break to triumph at the Fiji Pro just a couple of weeks later.

Lower Trestles, the surfing venue for the 2028 LA Olympics, is a very different kind of wave but one of the best in the sport's commercial homeland of Southern California and the cobblestone peak delivered high-performance, head-high waves for the finals.

After taking out five-times world champion Carissa Moore in their quarterfinal and Australia's reigning world champion Molly Picklum in the semifinal, Brooks got off to a strong start in the final against world No. 1 Gabriela Bryan, scoring 7.0 out of 10 for a series of sharp, accurate turns on her backhand.

Bryan keep herself in the contest with a 6.33 with some trademark powerful gouges on her forehand and backed it up with a 5.57 for a 11.90 total. But Brooks looked in control throughout, holding the lead after a second mid-range score and sealing the deal with another well-surfed right-hander as the clock wound down for a 6.0 and a 13-point total.

"The first part of the year was such a bummer, but this makes it worth it. So many hard heats just made me want to work even harder and now I've gotten to this point and I want to keep going," Brooks said after her win. "Last year, I went surfing (here) right after the girl's final and I could hear from the water them giving the trophies to someone else and I said to myself 'Next year, I want to do that for myself.'"

Brooks' three-peat was the first on the world tour since Australia's eight-time world champion Stephanie Gilmore did it in 2008.

Igarashi's parents moved to Southern California from Japan just before he was born, hoping he could become a professional surfer. The 28-year-old, who won silver for Japan at the Tokyo Olympics, took at early advantage in the final with a couple of mid-range scores with some powerful turns on his forehand on the crumbling walls and kept improving his scoreline, notching up a 7.67 and then a 6.73 to open up 14.40 total and a solid advantage.

But Pupo got the better of one exchange, caught the bigger second wave of a set and belted it multiple times on his backhand for an excellent 8.5. He then held his nerve and waited for a long left-hander on which he mixed up sharp turns and a small aerial to score a 6.27 for a 14.77 total and the lead as the clock wound down.

"It's been such hard work this year," said the 34-year-old, who is competing in his 16th year on tour. "I feel like this is my last shot at it, and so I'm going to do it all the way and I'm happy to come up with two wins."

The tour now breaks into a two-event "post-season" with contests for the top 24 men and 16 women in Portugal and the Philippines, before the whole field returns for the season finale at Hawaii's Pipeline in December.

เชียงราย.title: Chiang Rai Seeks Elite GI Status for Pangkhon Coffee Beans
เชียงราย.summary:
Chiang Rai is making a bold move to elevate its local coffee industry. The northern Thai province is actively seeking Geographical Indication (GI) registration for Pangkhon coffee. This prestigious label aims to boost the value and unique identity of this beloved highland product. By securing GI status, local farmers hope to place Pangkhon on the global specialty coffee map.

The push for GI certification represents a major milestone for highland agriculture. Grown in the mist-covered mountains of northern Thailand, this coffee boasts distinct flavors linked to its environment. A GI tag serves as a powerful guarantee of origin and quality for consumers worldwide. It also protects the heritage of the indigenous farmers who have cultivated these beans for decades.

The story of Pangkhon coffee is one of remarkable transformation and resilience. Decades ago, these high-altitude regions were heavily involved in the illicit cultivation of opium. Thanks to royal initiatives launched in the 1970s, farmers were encouraged to grow winter crops instead. Coffee quickly became a sustainable and legal alternative that changed the local economy forever.

Today, the lush hills of Pangkhon are covered in thriving Arabica coffee trees. The high elevation, which ranges from 1,250 to 1,500 meters, provides the perfect climate for beans. Cool mountain air allows the coffee cherries to mature slowly and develop incredibly complex flavors. This unique microclimate is precisely why the local coffee is now eligible for geographical protection.

Coffee experts often praise the unique tasting notes found exclusively in these highland beans. A typical cup offers a smooth, jammy profile with delightful hints of cranberry and chocolate. These distinct characteristics are deeply tied to the rich soil and traditional washing processes used. Attaining a GI label will officially recognize this unique flavor profile as exclusive to the region.

This GI initiative is strongly driven by a passionate group of new-generation farmers. These young agricultural entrepreneurs have eagerly returned to their home villages with fresh ideas. They are combining modern processing techniques with the invaluable traditional knowledge passed down from their parents. Their ultimate goal is to refine the bean quality and achieve greater consistency for international markets.

Gaining Geographical Indication status is about much more than just acquiring a fancy commercial label. It provides crucial legal protection against counterfeit products that falsely claim to be from Pang Khon. This ensures that the premium prices paid by coffee lovers actually reach the hardworking local producers. Ultimately, it empowers the community and actively encourages sustainable farming practices for the long-term future.

If successful, Pangkhon will join an elite group of officially recognized Thai coffees. Famous neighbors like Doi Tung and Doi Chaang already enjoy internationally protected GI status. These established brands have clearly proven that a geographical indication can dramatically boost tourism and exports. Chiang Rai officials are highly confident that Pangkhon possesses the exact same massive potential.

เชียงราย.title: Transboundary Pollution Law in the Mekong Region
เชียงราย.summary:
CHIANG RAI – A mine in Myanmar can release arsenic or mercury into a tributary that flows into Thailand, while a dam, wastewater discharge, plastic waste, or altered sediment flows upstream can affect farms, fisheries, and drinking water farther down the Mekong.

Recent concerns about Mekong arsenic pollution from Myanmar mines show why pollution can become an international legal issue before its source is fully identified.

Control is difficult because the river connects China, Myanmar, Laos, Thailand, Cambodia, and Vietnam, yet those countries don’t share one environmental regulator or the same legal obligations. The 1995 Mekong Agreement gives Cambodia, Laos, Thailand, and Vietnam useful cooperation rules through the Mekong River Commission, but China and Myanmar aren’t members, and the system can’t directly license or stop projects.

Instead, enforcement relies on consultation, data sharing, national permits, technical monitoring, and diplomacy. Those tools can improve transparency and coordination, but they remain limited and uneven when states disagree about pollution sources, disclose incomplete information, or prioritize development. The next sections explain what the regional framework requires, where its gaps appear, and why cooperation often matters more than formal penalties.

Transboundary pollution occurs when contamination or environmental damage in one country affects people, water, land, or ecosystems in another. A mine in Myanmar may release metals into a river that reaches Thailand, while wastewater discharged in Laos can affect communities and fisheries farther downstream.

The legal issue is broader than visible pollution. Changes to water flow, sediment movement, fish migration, or river habitats can also cause cross-border harm, even when no pollutant is released. A dam that traps sediment may alter downstream riverbanks and fisheries, while reduced flows can increase pollution concentrations during dry seasons.

These principles don’t create one regional pollution code with a single enforcement agency. Instead, the rules are spread across international law, regional agreements, national environmental laws, project permits, technical procedures, and diplomatic practice. The absence of a unified ASEAN framework remains a major concern, as shown by ongoing calls for ASEAN rules on cross-border pollution.

The wider Mekong region includes China, Myanmar, Laos, Thailand, Cambodia, and Vietnam. However, the 1995 Mekong Agreement directly binds only Thailand, Laos, Cambodia, and Vietnam. Those four countries created the Mekong River Commission and agreed to cooperate on the sustainable use and protection of shared water and related resources.

China and Myanmar are MRC dialogue partners rather than members. They share information and participate in technical discussions, but the agreement does not bind them in the same way. That distinction matters whenever pollution begins outside the treaty’s membership.

The 1995 Mekong Agreement is the central legal framework for Cambodia, Laos, Thailand, and Vietnam. It created the Mekong River Commission (MRC), with a Council for policy decisions, a Joint Committee for technical management, and a Secretariat for administrative and technical support. The agreement is mainly a cooperation framework, not a detailed pollution code with uniform limits or a regional enforcement agency.

เชียงราย.title: China Cold Air Mass Extends Thailand’s Rain Alerts to September 20
เชียงราย.summary:
CHIANG RAI – The Thai Meteorological Department has issued an urgent weather advisory for across Thailand. A strong cold air mass from China is actively pushing the monsoon trough southwards. This major weather shift will bring heavy to very heavy rain across Thailand through September 20.

Northern and northeastern provinces will feel the severe weather impact first. Soon after, the massive storm system will move toward the Central, Eastern, and Southern regions. Authorities are strongly warning local residents to prepare for sudden flash floods and rising rivers.

A powerful high-pressure weather system from China is driving these dangerous conditions. This cool air mass is rapidly spreading over the upper regions of northern Thailand. As the cold air moves south, it forces the active monsoon trough further down the map.

This massive shift brings intense, nonstop rainfall to the lower Central region and the East. The upper South is also bracing for heavy downpours throughout the rest of the week. At the same time, the local southwest monsoon is steadily gathering strength over the ocean. This active monsoon currently covers the Andaman Sea, the Gulf of Thailand, and the mainland.

Local officials warn that accumulated rainfall could easily trigger dangerous flash floods. Fast-moving forest runoff is a major safety concern for communities living near mountains. Low-lying areas and locations situated near major waterways are at the highest risk right now.

The heavy downpours will likely soak major agricultural areas and busy city centers alike. Farmers must work quickly to protect their crops from the rising waters. Meanwhile, city dwellers should prepare for severe traffic delays and localized street flooding.

The government is urging people to avoid traveling through any known flood zones. Short-term waterlogging can make low-lying city roads extremely dangerous for all drivers. If you must travel, please check local weather updates before you leave your home.

Local disaster agencies are closely monitoring water levels in major rivers and local reservoirs. They have strict instructions to warn residents immediately if the water rises too fast. Some high-risk districts already have emergency evacuation plans and temporary shelters in full swing.

Emergency response teams are currently on standby to assist with any required rescues. They have prepared flat-bottom boats and high-clearance vehicles to reach flooded neighborhoods safely. If floodwaters trap you in your home, contact local emergency services immediately for help.

The massive storm system is not just affecting the mainland and major cities. The Andaman Sea is facing very rough and dangerous conditions through the end of the week. Strong monsoon winds are whipping up massive waves along the entire southern coastline.

Weather forecasters expect standard ocean waves to reach two to three meters high. However, in open areas with active thunderstorms, these waves could easily exceed three meters. This unpredictable ocean activity creates a life-threatening situation for anyone out on the water.

Marine authorities have officially ordered all small boats in the Andaman Sea to remain ashore. Larger commercial ships must proceed with extreme caution and avoid storm cells entirely. Coastal residents should also prepare for potential storm surges and high coastal winds.

เชียงราย.title: How to Buy Chiang Rai Coffee Direct From Growers: A Practical Guide
เชียงราย.summary:
Buying Chiang Rai coffee close to its source can give you fresher beans, a clearer story about who grew them, and a more direct way to support local producers. “Direct from growers” may mean purchasing at a farm, through a farmer cooperative, from a community enterprise, or from a seller that clearly explains its direct pricing and traceability.

For visitors, the best-known growing areas include Doi Chang, Pangkhon, Doi Tung, Mae Salong, Mae Chedi, and Huai Chomphu. You might buy roasted coffee at an origin café, arrange a farm visit, or contact a cooperative before traveling. Overseas buyers can use producer-linked exporters, but should confirm the farm or group, processing method, harvest period, lot details, sample quality, and shipping terms before placing an order. This Chiang Rai coffee trail from Doi Chang to Doi Tung can also help you plan origin stops.

Prices vary by product, season, processing, order size, and delivery destination, so ask what the quoted price includes and how payment reaches producers. Start by comparing the main buying routes, then use the questions and shipping advice below to make a confident purchase.

Buying direct starts with choosing a clear origin and a seller that can explain its relationship with producers. Follow this process:

A named farm gives you the closest connection to the growing site. For example, Doi Chang Coffee Farm may sell roasted beans during a visit, but that doesn’t always mean green coffee is available. Visitors can use this Doi Chang coffee region guide to plan farm and café stops.

A community enterprise works at the village level. Mae Chan Tai Community Enterprise connects coffee production, processing, branding, and sales within the community. Akha Ama Coffee offers another producer-led route. Its business is linked to Mae Chan Tai and other northern communities, and its Mae Chan Tai coffee business explains the community ownership behind the brand.

FairNIST is a fair-trade buyer rather than a farm. Its model links named farmers in Ban Huai Nam Khun with downstream processing and roasting by Akha Ama. Bluekoff is a retail and roasting channel that sells Chiang Rai-origin coffee, while Beanspire may be useful as a specialty marketplace when it provides clear producer and lot information.

A reputable intermediary can still provide a direct farmer relationship. Look for a seller that explains:

For wholesale orders, ask about minimum quantities, milling, export documents, and sample approval. A farm visit usually suits roasted coffee purchases, while larger buyers may need a formal supply agreement.

A package labeled only “Thai coffee” gives you little to verify. A named lot identifies a place and often narrows the supply chain. QR codes and producer timelines can help, but a QR code alone doesn’t prove fair pricing. Ask for the payment model as well as the origin story, then confirm shipping and use a secure payment method.

Chiang Rai coffee can come from many mountain communities, so the origin name on a bag matters. Location, elevation, cherry selection, processing, and the producer model can all affect flavor and price. A named village or producer group usually tells you more than a broad label such as “Chiang Rai coffee.”

Prices vary by product, season, processing, order size, and delivery destination, so ask what the quoted price includes and how payment reaches producers. Start by comparing the main buying routes, then use the questions and shipping advice below to make a confident purchase.

Buying direct starts with choosing a clear origin and a seller that can explain its relationship with producers. Follow this process:

A named farm gives you the closest connection to the growing site. For example, Doi Chang Coffee Farm may sell roasted beans during a visit, but that doesn’t always mean green coffee is available. Visitors can use this Doi Chang coffee region guide to plan farm and café stops.

A community enterprise works at the village level. Mae Chan Tai Community Enterprise connects coffee production, processing, branding, and sales within the community. Akha Ama Coffee offers another producer-led route. Its business is linked to Mae Chan Tai and other northern communities, and its Mae Chan Tai coffee business explains the community ownership behind the brand.

FairNIST is a fair-trade buyer rather than a farm. Its model links named farmers in Ban Huai Nam Khun with downstream processing and roasting by Akha Ama. Bluekoff is a retail and roasting channel that sells Chiang Rai-origin coffee, while Beanspire may be useful as a specialty marketplace when it provides clear producer and lot information.

A reputable intermediary can still provide a direct farmer relationship. Look for a seller that explains:

For wholesale orders, ask about minimum quantities, milling, export documents, and sample approval. A farm visit usually suits roasted coffee purchases, while larger buyers may need a formal supply agreement.

A package labeled only “Thai coffee” gives you little to verify. A named lot identifies a place and often narrows the supply chain. QR codes and producer timelines can help, but a QR code alone doesn’t prove fair pricing. Ask for the payment model as well as the origin story, then confirm shipping and use a secure payment method.

Chiang Rai coffee can come from many mountain communities, so the origin name on a bag matters. Location, elevation, cherry selection, processing, and the producer model can all affect flavor and price. A named village or producer group usually tells you more than a broad label such as “Chiang Rai coffee.”

เชียงราย.title: ทหารพราน ไล่ล่า เก๋งลำเลียงยาเสพติด-เสียหลักตกถนน คนขับหนีเข้าป่า ตรวจรถซุกไอซ์72กิโล
เชียงราย.summary:
เชียงราย ทหารพราน กองกำลังผาเมือง สกัดกั้น ไล่ล่า เก๋งลักลอบ ลำเลียงยาเสพติด สั่งให้หยุด ไม่จอด เร่งเครื่องหนี- เสียหลักตกข้างทาง คนร้าย ทิ้งรถเผ่นเข้าป่า ตรวจสอบในรถ พบซุก ไอซ์ 72 กิโล
19 ก.ย. 69 – ร้อย.ทพ.3106 ฉก.ทพ.31 ภายใต้การอำนวยการ พลตรีสาธิต ไวยนนท์ ผู้บัญชาการกองกำลังผาเมือง พันเอกจีกรพงษ์ สอดสี ผู้บังคับหน่วยเฉพาะกิจ กรมทหารพรานที่ 31 กองกำลังผาเมือง ร่วมกับเจ้าหน้าที่ตำรวจ สภ.แม่จัน ฝ่ายปกครอง พร้อมด้วยหน่วยงานที่เกี่ยวข้อง ได้ร่วมกันสกัดกั้นยาเสพติดสามารถตรวจยึดยาไอซ์นำหนักประมาณ 72 กิโลกรัม
โดยการสกัดกั้นครั้งนี้ เจ้าหน้าที่ได้รับแจ้งจากพลเมืองดีว่า จะมีการลักลอบลำเลียงยาเสพติดจากพื้นที่ อ.แม่ฟ้าหลวง จ.เชียงราย เข้าสู่พื้นที่ตอนใน จึงจัดกำลังตั้งจุดตรวจ และจุดสกัด บริเวณบ้านห้วยมะหินฝน ต.ป่าตึง อ.แม่จัน จ.เชียงราย

กระทั่งพบรถยนต์ต้องสงสัยขับเข้ามายังจุดตรวจ เจ้าหน้าที่จึงเรียกให้หยุดเพื่อขอตรวจสอบ แต่รถคันดังกล่าวกลับเร่งเครื่องหลบหนี เจ้าหน้าที่จึงไล่ติดตาม กระทั่งรถเสียหลักตกลงข้างทาง โดย คนร้ายอาศัยความชำนาญในพื้นที่หลบหนีไปได้
เจ้าหน้าที่เข้าตรวจสอบ พบเป็นรถยนต์สีขาว และพบกระสอบฟางหลากสีวางอยู่บริเวณด้านหลังเบาะคนขับ ภายในบรรจุยาเสพติดให้โทษประเภท 1 (ไอซ์)
จากการตรวจสอบร่วมกันระหว่าง ร้อย.ทพ.3106 ฉก.ทพ.31, นบ.ยส.35, สภ.แม่จัน และฝ่ายความมั่นคง อ.แม่จัน พบไอซ์บรรจุในถุงชาสีเขียว ห่อหุ้มด้วยถุงพลาสติกใส บรรจุอยู่ในกระสอบฟางจำนวน 3 กระสอบ กระสอบละ 24 ถุง น้ำหนักถุงละ 1 กก. รวมทั้งสิ้น 72 กก.
พร้อมยึด รถยนต์ สีขาว 1 คัน เจ้าหน้าที่ จึงนำของกลางทั้งหมดส่ง สภ.แม่จัน เพื่อดำเนินการตามกฎหมาย ติดตามตัวผู้ขับขี่มาดำเนินคดี

เชียงราย.title: Chiang Rai Expands Women’s Leadership Drive
เชียงราย.summary:
CHIANG RAI – The northern city of Chiang Rai is rolling out a fresh initiative to empower its local women. Officials recently launched a dedicated mobile outreach program designed to build strong women community leaders.

This innovative project travels directly into rural districts to make valuable training accessible for everyone. The program aims to give these women a much bigger voice in vital local decision-making.

Historically, professional development programs required rural residents to travel long distances into the busy city center. Today, this mobile outreach brings essential resources directly to the quiet neighborhoods where women actually live.

Traveling training teams offer hands-on workshops focused on public speaking, practical problem-solving, and grassroots community organizing. These critical skills prepare women to confidently step into important local leadership roles with relative ease.

For decades, men have consistently held the vast majority of local government and community council positions. This new initiative actively seeks to change that outdated dynamic by supporting and elevating female voices.

Local authorities finally understand that diverse viewpoints lead to significantly better choices for the whole community. Therefore, they are currently investing heavily in grassroots education, practical skill-building, and ongoing professional mentorship.

Organizers primarily focus on teaching practical skills that make a real difference in daily community life. They teach women how to properly manage local budgets, plan community events, and address public concerns. By mastering these valuable skills, eager participants can confidently run for important local government office positions. Additionally, they can effectively lead neighborhood committees that directly influence public policy and local tax spending.

This hands-on approach is already creating a very strong ripple effect across the entire northern province. As one courageous woman steps up, she naturally inspires other residents in her village to participate.

This growing network of female leaders actively creates a highly supportive environment for future younger generations. Young girls now clearly see positive examples of female authority operating natively in their own hometowns.

Many local advocacy groups are now widely praising this innovative approach to progressive rural community building. Empowering women at the local level completely transforms entire societies.

Chiang Rai is proudly proving that local governance works best when absolutely everyone has a seat. This mobile program successfully ensures that physical geography no longer blocks access to crucial leadership opportunities.

The dedicated mobile outreach teams travel with a full curriculum specifically designed for common rural challenges. They carefully partner with village elders to ensure the training respects deeply rooted local cultural traditions.

This careful balance of modern leadership strategies and traditional values quickly builds incredibly deep community trust. Consequently, more supportive families are now enthusiastically encouraging their mothers and daughters to actively step forward.

Professional mentorship plays a massive role in the overall ongoing success of this mobile leadership drive. Experienced female leaders regularly pair up with eager newcomers to offer practical guidance and emotional support.

พิษณุโลก.title: ส.อ.ท. เตือนภาคอุตสาหกรรมรับมือ ‘สองความเสี่ยงน้ำ’ เฝ้าระวังน้ำท่วมเฉพาะพื้นที่–เร่งวางแผนน้ำต้นทุนรับฤดูแล้ง
พิษณุโลก.summary:
ส.อ.ท. เตือนภาคอุตสาหกรรมรับมือ ‘สองความเสี่ยงน้ำ’ เฝ้าระวังน้ำท่วมเฉพาะพื้นที่–เร่งวางแผนน้ำต้นทุนรับฤดูแล้ง
เมื่อวันที่ 19 กันยายน สภาอุตสาหกรรมแห่งประเทศไทย (ส.อ.ท.) ติดตามสถานการณ์ฝนและน้ำทั่วประเทศ โดยเห็นว่าภาคอุตสาหกรรมต้องบริหารความเสี่ยง 2 ด้านควบคู่กัน ได้แก่ ฝนตกหนักและน้ำท่วมเฉพาะพื้นที่ในระยะสั้น และ ความเพียงพอของน้ำต้นทุนสำหรับฤดูแล้ง ซึ่งมีระดับความเสี่ยงแตกต่างกันในแต่ละพื้นที่
นายปรีดา วัชรเธียรสกุล รองประธานสภาอุตสาหกรรมแห่งประเทศไทย (ส.อ.ท.) และประธานสถาบันน้ำ สิ่งแวดล้อม และ Climate Change กล่าวว่า “สถานการณ์ขณะนี้สะท้อนว่า ภาคอุตสาหกรรมต้องรับมือความเสี่ยงด้านน้ำทั้งสองด้านพร้อมกัน คือ ป้องกันผลกระทบจากฝนตกหนักและน้ำท่วมในระยะสั้น ควบคู่กับการประเมินน้ำต้นทุนและวางแผนใช้น้ำสำหรับฤดูแล้ง เพราะฝนที่ตกหนักในบางช่วงไม่ได้หมายความว่าทุกพื้นที่จะมีน้ำเพียงพอ”
ทั้งนี้ ส.อ.ท. เสนอแนะแนวทางรับมือ ดังนี้
1. เฝ้าระวังฝนตกหนักและน้ำท่วมเฉพาะพื้นที่ ข้อมูลจากสถาบันสารสนเทศทรัพยากรน้ำ (องค์การมหาชน) ณ วันที่ 18 กันยายน 2569 ระบุว่า ช่วงวันที่ 18–20 กันยายน 2569 หลายพื้นที่ต้องเฝ้าระวังน้ำท่วมฉับพลัน น้ำป่าไหลหลาก น้ำท่วมขังในเขตเมือง และน้ำล้นตลิ่ง
พื้นที่เสี่ยงจากฝนสะสม 24 ชั่วโมง ได้แก่ พิษณุโลก จันทบุรี ตราด นครพนม น่าน แพร่ กระบี่ ชุมพร ตรัง พังงา ระนอง และสุราษฎร์ธานี รวมถึงพื้นที่ที่มีฝนตกสะสมต่อเนื่อง
สำหรับภาคอุตสาหกรรม น้ำท่วมอาจส่งผลกระทบต่อระบบไฟฟ้า เครื่องจักร การจัดเก็บวัตถุดิบ สารเคมีและสินค้า ตลอดจนเส้นทางขนส่งและห่วงโซ่อุปทาน ส.อ.ท. จึงขอให้สถานประกอบการในพื้นที่เสี่ยงเร่งดำเนินการ ดังนี้
ตรวจสอบระบบระบายน้ำ แนวป้องกันน้ำท่วม และจุดเสี่ยงภายในโรงงาน
ป้องกันเครื่องจักร ระบบไฟฟ้า วัตถุดิบ สารเคมี และสินค้า
เตรียมพลังงานสำรอง ระบบสื่อสาร และกำหนดผู้รับผิดชอบกรณีฉุกเฉิน
ติดตามระดับน้ำ ประกาศเตือนภัย และเส้นทางขนส่งอย่างต่อเนื่อง
ทบทวนแผนฉุกเฉินและแผนความต่อเนื่องทางธุรกิจ (BCP)
2. ฝนสะสมต่ำกว่าปกติ ต้องเร่งวางแผนน้ำต้นทุน ปริมาณฝนสะสมทั่วประเทศระหว่างวันที่ 1 มกราคม–13 กันยายน 2569 อยู่ที่ 1,032.6 มิลลิเมตร พื้นที่ที่มีปริมาณฝนสะสมต่ำกว่าค่าปกติมาก ได้แก่ ภาคใต้ฝั่งตะวันออกร้อยละ 28 ภาคกลางร้อยละ 18 และภาคตะวันออกร้อยละ 13 สะท้อนให้เห็นว่าปริมาณและการกระจายตัวของฝนแตกต่างกันในแต่ละพื้นที่ จึงจำเป็นต้องเร่งประเมินความเพียงพอของน้ำต้นทุนก่อนเข้าสู่ฤดูแล้ง
3. น้ำในอ่างทั่วประเทศอยู่ที่ร้อยละ 72 แต่ต้องประเมินเป็นรายพื้นที่ ข้อมูลกรมชลประทาน ณ วันที่ 18 กันยายน 2569 ระบุว่า อ่างเก็บน้ำขนาดใหญ่และขนาดกลาง 496 แห่ง มีน้ำเก็บกักรวม 55,015 ล้านลูกบาศก์เมตร หรือร้อยละ 72 ของความจุ และมีน้ำใช้การได้ 31,041 ล้านลูกบาศก์เมตร หรือร้อยละ 59 อย่างไรก็ตาม ปริมาณน้ำเก็บกักรวมยังต่ำกว่าช่วงเดียวกันของปี 2568 จำนวน 4,210 ล้านลูกบาศก์เมตร จึงไม่ควรประเมินความเพียงพอของน้ำจากค่าเฉลี่ยระดับประเทศเพียงอย่างเดียว
พื้นที่ที่ภาคอุตสาหกรรมควรติดตามเป็นพิเศษ
-ภาคกลาง มีน้ำเก็บกักร้อยละ 62 และมีฝนสะสมต่ำกว่าค่าปกติร้อยละ 18 จึงควรติดตามปริมาณน้ำในแหล่งน้ำอย่างใกล้ชิด
-ภาคตะวันออก ซึ่งเป็นฐานเศรษฐกิจและอุตสาหกรรมสำคัญ มีน้ำเก็บกักร้อยละ 68 และฝนสะสมต่ำกว่าค่าปกติร้อยละ 13 จึงต้องติดตามทั้งปริมาณน้ำต้นทุนและสมดุลระหว่างปริมาณน้ำที่มีอยู่กับความต้องการใช้น้ำ (Water Balance) โดยเฉพาะพื้นที่ EEC เพื่อประเมินความเพียงพอของน้ำสำหรับภาคการผลิตในช่วงฤดูแล้ง
-ภาคตะวันออกเฉียงเหนือ มีน้ำเก็บกักร้อยละ 72 และฝนสะสมต่ำกว่าค่าปกติร้อยละ 6 จึงควรใช้ช่วงที่ยังมีฝนเร่งกักเก็บน้ำ พร้อมติดตามปริมาณฝนและน้ำไหลเข้าอ่างอย่างต่อเนื่อง
-ภาคใต้ มีน้ำเก็บกักร้อยละ 65 ขณะที่ภาคใต้ฝั่งตะวันออกมีฝนสะสมต่ำกว่าค่าปกติถึงร้อยละ 28 จึงต้องติดตามการกระจายตัวของฝนและประเมินน้ำต้นทุนเป็นรายพื้นที่
นอกจากนี้ ควรติดตามสถานการณ์ ENSO และแนวโน้มเอลนีโญอย่างต่อเนื่อง เนื่องจากอาจส่งผลต่อปริมาณฝนและความเสี่ยงด้านน้ำในระยะต่อไป
4. จัดทำแผนบริหารน้ำ 3 ระดับ
ส.อ.ท. แนะนำให้สถานประกอบการประ…

พิษณุโลก.title: นายกฯ ควงภริยา ไหว้พระวันหยุด ขอพรพระพุทธชินราช ลงยันต์ฝ่ามือกับหลวงพ่อสำลี คู่กัน
พิษณุโลก.summary:
นายกฯ ควงภริยา ไหว้พระวันหยุด ขอพรพระพุทธชินราช ลงยันต์ฝ่ามือ หลวงพ่อสำลี คู่กัน
เมื่อเวลา 14.13 น. วันที่ 19 กันยายน นายอนุทิน ชาญวีรกูล นายกรัฐมนตรีและรมว.มหาดไทย ใช้ช่วงวันหยุดเดินทางไปไหว้พระขอพร ที่วัดราชบูรณะ จ.พิษณุโลก พร้อมนางธนนนท์ ชาญวีรกูล ภริยา ก่อนที่จะเดินทางเข้าร่วมการประชุมสมัชชาสหประชาชาติ สมัยสามัญ ครั้งที่ 81 (The 81st Session of the United Nations General Assembly: UNGA81) ระหว่างวันที่ 20–27 ก.ย.69 ที่นครนิวยอร์ก สหรัฐอเมริกา

พิษณุโลก.title: เที่ยววัดวันหยุด – พิพิธภัณฑ์ฯ-พระพุทธชินราช ชมศิลปวัตถุลำ้ค่า-โบราณ
พิษณุโลก.summary:
“พิพิธภัณฑสถานแห่งชาติ พระพุทธ ชินราช” เมื่อแรกสร้างเป็นพิพิธภัณฑ์ที่อยู่ในความดูแลของวัดพระศรีรัตนมหาธาตุ วรมหาวิหาร ต.ในเมือง อ.เมือง จ.พิษณุโลก โดยใช้พื้นที่ของพระวิหารพระพุทธชินสีห์และพระวิหารพระศรีศาสดา เป็นที่จัดแสดงโบราณวัตถุ ศิลปวัตถุประเภทต่างๆ

ต่อมากรมศิลปากรได้ประกาศจัดตั้งเป็นพิพิธภัณฑสถานแห่งชาติ พระพุทธ ชินราช เมื่อพุทธศักราช 2504 และได้ก่อสร้างอาคารพิพิธภัณฑสถานแห่งชาติ พระพุทธชินราช เมื่อพุทธศักราช 2557

จากนั้นสำนักศิลปากรที่ 6 สุโขทัย จึงได้ดำเนินโครงการจัดแสดงนิทรรศการถาวร พิพิธภัณฑสถานแห่งชาติ พระพุทธชินราช โดยเริ่มดำเนินการพัฒนาและปรับปรุงมาเป็นลำดับตั้งแต่ปี 2561 กระทั่งแล้วเสร็จสมบูรณ์ในปีนี้

การจัดแสดงนิทรรศการถาวรภายในอาคารได้รวบรวมโบราณวัตถุ ศิลปวัตถุที่มีประวัติเกี่ยวเนื่องกับพระพุทธชินราช และวัดพระศรีรัตนมหาธาตุวรมหาวิหาร จ.พิษณุโลก ตั้งแต่อดีตจนถึงปัจจุบัน ซึ่งโบราณวัตถุเหล่านี้เป็นสิ่งของที่มีผู้ถวายแด่พระพุทธชินราชเป็นพุทธบูชา ทั้งพระมหากษัตริย์ พระบรมวงศานุวงศ์ และประชาชนทั่วไป แสดงให้เห็นถึงความศรัทธาที่มีต่อพระพุทธชินราช เช่น สังวาลประดับองค์พระพุทธชินราช และสายสะพายเครื่องราชอิสริยาภรณ์อันเป็นโบราณมงคลนพรัตนราช วราภรณ์ ต้นไม้เงินต้นไม้ทองที่ถวายโดยพระมหากษัตริย์และพระบรมวงศานุวงศ์

นอกจากนี้ ยังมีโบราณวัตถุที่พบจากการขุดค้นทางโบราณคดีในเขตจังหวัดพิษณุโลกและโบราณวัตถุที่เกี่ยวข้องกับพระพุทธชินราชจากพิพิธภัณฑสถาน แห่งชาติแห่งอื่นๆ แบ่งการจัดแสดงออกเป็น 9 ส่วน ได้แก่
1.ส่วนจัดแสดงราช-ราษฎร์ศรัทธาบูชาพระพุทธชินราช จัดแสดงเรื่องราวพระราชศรัทธาของพระมหากษัตริย์ พระบรมวงศานุวงศ์ ตลอดจนความศรัทธาของประชาชนผ่านหลักฐานที่เป็นสิ่งของต่างๆ ซึ่งนำมาถวายพระพุทธชินราช เช่น ต้นไม้เงิน ต้นไม้ทอง เครื่องแก้วเจียระไน เครื่องตามประทีป เป็นต้น
2.ส่วนจัดแสดงย้อนอดีตกาลโบราณคดีและประวัติศาสตร์พิษณุโลก นำเสนอพัฒนาการทางประวัติศาสตร์ของพิษณุโลก ตั้งแต่อดีตถึงปัจจุบัน ตลอดจนความสำคัญของเมืองพิษณุโลกในช่วงระยะเวลาต่างๆ รวมถึงบทบาท สถานะของเมืองพิษณุโลกที่มีความสัมพันธ์กับสุโขทัยและกรุงศรี อยุธยา

3.ส่วนจัดแสดงวัดพระศรีรัตนมหาธาตุ วรมหาวิหาร เมืองพิษณุโลก และพระพุทธชินราช จัดแสดงเรื่องราวเกี่ยวกับประวัติความเป็นมา การบูรณปฏิสังขรณ์วัดพระศรีรัตนมหาธาตุวรมหาวิหาร เมืองพิษณุโลก การเสด็จพระราชดำเนินมานมัสการพระพุทธชินราชของพระมหากษัตริย์ ตำนานประวัติและพุทธศิลป์ของพระพุทธชินราช

4.ส่วนจัดแสดงพุทธบูชาราชรัตนาภรณ์ จัดแสดงสังวาลประดับองค์พระพุทธ ชินราช และสายสะพายเครื่องราชอิสริยาภรณ์ อันเป็นโบราณมงคลนพรัตนราชวราภรณ์ ซึ่งพระมหากษัตริย์ถวายเป็นพุทธบูชาแด่พระพุทธชินราช เพื่อแสดงถึงความสำคัญและความศรัทธาที่มีต่อพระพุทธชินราชของพระมหากษัตริย์ไทย
5.ส่วนจัดแสดงกลองมโหระทึก จัดแสดง โบราณวัตถุประเภทกลองมโหระทึกที่ วัดพระศรีรัตนมหาธาตุวรมหาวิหาร พิษณุโลก ได้เก็บรักษาไว้

6.ส่วนจัดแสดงพุทธศิลปงาสลัก จัดแสดง โบราณวัตถุประเภทงาช้างและงาช้างแกะสลัก ที่ประชาชนถวายพระพุทธชินราชเป็นพุทธบูชา
7.ส่วนจัดแสดงพุทธพิมพปฏิมา จัดแสดง โบราณวัตถุประเภทพระพุทธรูปบุเงินบุทอง พระพุทธรูปแก้ว ที่ประชาชนถวายเป็นพุทธบูชาแด่พระพุทธชินราช

8.ส่วนจัดแสดงโบราณวัตถุประเภทเครื่องไม้ จัดแสดงโบราณวัตถุประเภทเครื่องไม้ ที่วัดพระศรีรัตนมหาธาตุ วรมหาวิหาร พิษณุโลกได้เก็บรักษาไว้ เช่น ยานมาศ ตู้พระธรรม ดาวประดับเพดาน พระปรางค์วัดพระศรีรัตนมหาธาตุ วรมหาวิหาร จังหวัดพิษณุโลก เป็นต้น
9.ส่วนจัดแสดงโบราณวัตถุที่ประชาชนถวายพระพุทธชินราชเป็นพุทธบูชา เช่น เครื่องแก้ว เจียระไน เครื่องถ้วย ลายคราม เครื่องเบญจรงค์ เครื่องทองเหลือง เป็นต้น
พิพิธภัณฑสถานแห่งชาติ พระพุทธชินราช เปิดให้บริการโดยไม่เก็บค่าธรรมเนียมเข้าชม ทุกวันพุธ-วันอาทิตย์ เวลา 08.30-16.00 น. (ปิดวันจันทร์-วันอังคาร และวันหยุดนักขัตฤกษ์)

8.ส่วนจัดแสดงโบราณวัตถุประเภทเครื่องไม้ จัดแสดงโบราณวัตถุประเภทเครื่องไม้ ที่วัดพระศรีรัตนมหาธาตุ วรมหาวิหาร พิษณุโลกได้เก็บรักษาไว้ เช่น ยานมาศ ตู้พระธรรม ดาวประดับเพดาน พระปรางค์วัดพระศรีรัตนมหาธาตุ วรมหาวิหาร จังหวัดพิษณุโลก เป็นต้น
9.ส่วนจัดแสดงโบราณวัตถุที่ประชาชนถวายพระพุทธชินราชเป็นพุทธบูชา เช่น เครื่องแก้ว เจียระไน เครื่องถ้วย ลายคราม เครื่องเบญจรงค์ เครื่องทองเหลือง เป็นต้น

ท่านผู้อ่านโปรดทราบ ตามหลักวิชาโหราศาสตร์ไทย ยึดถือว่าแรงดึงดูดระหว่างดาวพระเคราะห์มีอิทธิพลต่อชีวิต จิตใจ และการกระทำของมนุษย์แต่ละคน ดาวพระเคราะห์โคจรเคลื่อนที่ไปแต่ละวัน จะมีอิทธิพลต่อลัคนา (ลั) ผ่านเรือนชะตา

general.summary:

general.summary:

general.title_original: Australian man accused of teenage girl’s murder pleads not guilty
general.summary_original:
BANGKOK (AP) — An Australian man pleaded not guilty in court Friday to charges of murder and concealment of a body in connection with the death of a teenage girl in an eastern Thai tourist city, officials said.

Simon Peter Carman was arrested in June after the 17-year-old girl was reported missing in Pattaya City, about 150 kilometers (93 miles) southeast of Bangkok, and a suitcase containing her body was found soon afterward.

Prosecutors indicted Carman on Thursday, according to Pattaya City Police. He was also charged with two counts of committing indecent acts on a minor.

The Pattaya Provincial Court said in a press release that Carman consulted with his attorney and denied all charges, saying that he was acting in self-defense and that he did not know the girl’s real age. It said his request to be released on bail was denied due to flight risk.

The court scheduled an Oct. 12 hearing to examine the evidence.

Carman is being detained at Pattaya Remand Prison.

A conviction on the charge of premeditated murder carries the possibility of a death penalty.

Police said the girl was last seen on security footage walking into a condominium with Carman. He was later seen leaving the building alone with a large suitcase. Security footage showed him loading it onto a motorbike and riding into a deserted area along the railway.

Carman was arrested at a Bangkok airport before boarding a flight to Australia. Police said subsequent questioning led them to the suitcase with the girl’s body.

In a police interrogation video shared online by Thai media, Carman said he was defending himself because the girl was threatening him with a knife.

general.title_original: 10-year-old Lotto wins Thailand go-kart championship title
general.summary_original:
CHONBURI — 13 September 2026, Ten-year-old go-karting sensation Phattharaphon “Lotto” Pun-ngam announced himself on the national stage by winning the annual ROK Cup Thailand 2026 title after finishing on the podium in all four rounds of the season.

The final round of the ROK Cup Thailand 2026 national championship was held at Bira Kart Circuit in Chonburi on 12-13 September, with Lotto competing in the Mini ROK U10 class for newcomer team Kartwerks.

Driving car No. 59, Lotto battled at the front throughout the final round before crossing the finish line second in 13:45.653.

Chotthanin Ittiachararat of Top One Motorsport won the race in 13:45.358, just 0.295 seconds ahead of Lotto, while Phannaphat Prawatrungreung finished third in 13:46.236.

The second-place finish gave Lotto enough points to move to the top of the overall championship standings. He finished the four-round season with 140 points, ahead of Achira Phianphak of NRT Racing Team on 101 points and Chotthanin on 97.

Lotto’s championship campaign was marked by consistent podium finishes throughout the season.

He opened the season by winning the first round and continued his strong form in Round 2, where he topped qualifying with a fastest lap of 57.169 seconds before winning the 15-lap final in 15:56.872. He finished more than four seconds ahead of runner-up Joshua Tan.

In Round 3, Lotto again set a strong qualifying time of 57.216 seconds per lap before finishing third in a closely contested final.

Achira won that race in 14:34.757, followed by Chotthanin in 14:34.937. Lotto finished just 0.376 seconds behind the winner in 14:35.133.

He then secured another second-place finish in the final round to complete a podium run across all four rounds and collect enough points to claim the 2026 ROK Cup Thailand championship.

The title marks a breakthrough for Lotto, who is only in his second year of serious karting competition. It is also the first competitive season for Kartwerks, which is managed by team owner and manager Win Chariya Nuya.

A former national karting champion, Nuya has used his experience to guide the young driver in training, kart setup and race strategy, helping Lotto’s No. 59 machine remain competitive throughout the season.

Other championship winners in the ROK Cup Thailand 2026 season included Chinnaphat Wechaphuti, who topped the Mini ROK standings with 145 points, narrowly beating Setthaphat Theeraphatbuawong on 143.

In the Junior ROK GP, Kawin Suphawanishayanon finished first with 143 points.

Poch Khongchon topped the Rookies Junior ROK GP standings with 141 points, while Yehonatan Moshe won the Senior ROK GP title with 150 points.

In the Expert ROK GP, Ian Whillock finished first with 80 points.

general.title_original: Shooting at high school in the Philippines kills at least 3 young people, injures 6
general.summary_original:
MANILA, Philippines (AP) — A shooting at a high school in the southern Philippines on Friday left at least three young people dead and six others injured, including the gunman, a local official said.

Rolly Doane Aquino, a provincial disaster response official in South Cotabato province, said three people were killed and six others were hospitalized after the shooting at Banga National High School in the town of Banga.

The Philippine National Police confirmed in a statement that three people had died and several others had been wounded. The circumstances of the shooting remained under investigation.

South Cotabato Gov. Reynaldo Tamayo said the gunman’s best friend told officials that he was a member of a “true crime community.” Tamayo said authorities would investigate the claim.

หลังจาก ประธานาธิบดีโดนัลด์ ทรัมป์ ผู้นำสหรัฐ ข่มขู่มานานหลายเดือนว่าจะใช้กำลังยึดครองกรีนแลนด์โดยอ้างเหตุผลด้านความมั่นคงของชาติ และชี้ถึงทำเลที่ตั้งเชิงยุทธศาสตร์สำหรับการป้องกันประเทศ รวมทั้งทรัพยากรแร่ธาตุอันมั่งคั่งของดินแดนแห่งนี้
